title: Application Shell
summary: A responsive application shell that preserves primary navigation and main-content hierarchy without turning every region into a card.

use_when: A product has recurring destinations and benefits from persistent application structure
Navigation and content need stable landmarks across repeated tasks
avoid_when: A single-purpose page does not need persistent application navigation
Marketing pages where the information architecture is fundamentally different

accessibility: Expose header, navigation, main, and complementary regions with appropriate native landmarks.
Provide a visible main-content target for skip navigation.
Do not remove core navigation destinations at narrow widths; adapt their presentation.
